limitations: The 08:41 original ELF manifest anchors the completed morning version. The included source tree was captured at 09:19 before the later log-audit; exact source correspondence is established by a matching ROM Build ID in a separate validation build.
The 20:25 output-path harness report with main.c SHA 59a8... is later evidence and is not the source selected for this archive; the archived 09:19 main.c hash is recorded above.
The camera package is the pre-ring CACHED_WIDTH_TURNRESPONSE_20261014 package; all 17 runtime files match the final turn-response source-hashes.csv current_sha256 field.
This archive excludes later ring, log-audit, and PI behavior code and makes no claim of physical validation or user flashing.
